c64_coverage.note: compiled basic labels; and edges with comparison outcomes (clang -O0 -fsanitize-coverage=trace-pc-guard,trace-cmp over every linked source but the host runner: both outcomes of each branch, and equal/less/greater at each comparison) that the differential's cases reach, and those the C64 cases reach

c64_gcov_branches.note: gcov -b -c over gcc -O0 --coverage builds of tools/interp_routine_native.c with every source above: the branch outcomes all the differential cases take, and those the C64 cases take

outcome_cover.method: clang -fsanitize-coverage=trace-pc-guard edges (each branch outcome) over every linked source but the test harness, per case (tools/irc_edges.c)

boundary: from each routine entry state to NEWOPS with LOC outside the file, an exit of the interpreter bodies (lm: POODOO1, ALARM1; cm: POODOO, ALARM), or a transfer to an outside basic routine (lm: CHANG2, DOWNFLAG, UPFLAG, VNPOOH); whole-file basic code stops at any transfer from the file to a fixed address outside it but INTPRET (stored words the file transfers to in erasable run on)
compared: Z, 2048 erasable words (A, L 16-bit) and the interrupt-enable state
engine: pinned yaAGC, its ScalerCounter held at 0 (TIME1-TIME6 and the timer interrupts do not advance during a case)
start_state: every word of the image from the case seed, 010-061 included (TIME1-TIME6, the CDUs, PIPAs and other counters, the interrupt save words, the editing registers; IRC_COUNTERS in tests/interp_case.h), then the case edits; half the cases also tie words the file reads together (relate(): one equal to another, a few counts or a double word apart, TIME2/TIME1, TIME3-TIME6, the CDUs and CDU commands included) or put a counter at its wrap
